note: Regional park on Suffern Lake in the Manitou Sand Hills near Senlac. The small lake is stocked with rainbow and brook trout and has a 5 km/h limit for all boats; a boat launch with fish-filleting stations sits at its south-east end. Beach with a playground and an outdoor shower, a store selling ice cream, firewood and ice, a free nine-hole artificial-green golf course, and a hall for rent. Some sites need up to 40 ft of cord and hose to reach the hookups, and site 37 is very small. No jet skis or ATVs in the park. --Claude
